steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Open Claw 这类开源智能体可随处运行、兼容任意模型，让非程序员也能编程；但开源可能财务上不可持续，项目也应对热门 PR 说不以保持主见。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计不可或缺，设计师应追随好奇心、动手试错，让个人印记留在产品上，而非始终作为一个整体团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling; personality and feeling make utilitarian products memorable.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，平衡直觉与数据的主线一以贯之：用数据辅助决策，但最终靠愿景与感觉；注入情感与个性让实用产品令人难忘。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts let Claude handle mockups while designers focus on ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；提供丰富上下文与明确指令，让 Claude 承担原型图工作，设计师则专注于想法。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and rough shipping is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；过早入场胜过精雕细琢，粗糙发布也可接受。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and excel at busy work; humans retain a monopoly on design thinking, so designers should walk, think, and request sheer volume of options.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型缺乏品味、擅长杂活，人类仍垄断设计思考；因此设计师应多散步思考，并以数量换取可选方案。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the boundary blurry.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者边界变得模糊。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization), each needing workload-specific calibration.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类，各自需要针对具体工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC; inference work shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and KV cache management.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；推理工作从写内核转向基础设施编排与 KV 缓存管理。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理仍需人类担责：可用性不能靠氛围编程。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL enable infinite post-training tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习让后训练任务无限生成，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此产品开发中需用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, not fixed ones.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍是涉及人类判断的主观艺术，需多样基准评估创意写作与情商，而非固定基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, limiting diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，需持续演进基准；服务数十亿人的单一模型会收敛为平均声音，限制多样性。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and stay relevant, applying post-training to non-tech creative industries.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识并保持相关性，将后训练应用于非技术创意产业。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing are the correct way to build and sell AI software; frontier model development is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体与按结果定价是构建和销售 AI 软件的正确方式；前沿模型开发属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; fixing their wrong code needs root-cause analysis, and inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从作者变成操作者；修复其错误代码需根因分析，且推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI agents become the new app, with specialized vendors winning long-tail domains; incumbents face business-model, not just technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：应用型 AI 智能体成为新应用，专业厂商赢下长尾领域；在位者面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and intelligence; responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety, not waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让专业知识与智能民主化；负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是安全之路，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI will create more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding yet elevate the role, and adoption pace is unprecedented.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于他本人却提升了角色价值，且采用速度前所未有。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you must feed superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and a design system to get value.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的价值，必须喂给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在完成 80% 时就发布，并基于真实反馈迭代；完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而非分散或融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌大多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的应用场景，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, and deep code understanding still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means agents run profitably without humans.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是智能体能无人工干预地持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: From reshoring optimism to agent management: everyone gets an agent, but humans must care for and oversee agents; the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年的回流乐观，到 2026 年转向智能体管理：人人都有智能体，但需人类照看与监督；“AI 就业末日”是谎言，SaaS 不亡反增。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; one company-wide super agent beats personal agents; benchmarks overstate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他判断工作界面转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 等 GUI，主张全公司一个超级智能体而非每人一个，并指出基准高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste stay human, automation commoditizes frozen competencies and creates more expert work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年深化为：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态；技艺与品味仍属人类，自动化把“冻结的能力”商品化，反而创造更多专家工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent thread: AI remains tool-like, needing human direction, oversight and explanation—even superintelligence won't replace human judgment.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具式的，需要人类引导、监督与解释——即便走向超级智能，也不会取代人类判断。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，重点应放在教模型真实工程特性和产品界面上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; independence allows model neutrality and long-term enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近，独立性允许模型中立和长期企业合作。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiments, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，科学将从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to weeks and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法会把临床试验从数年压缩到数周，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biology; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging can be reversed within 15 years via partial reprogramming, reaching longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 衰老可在 15 年内被逆转，通过部分重编程在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should nearly fully trust superintelligence for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不用它是不道德的；医疗决策上应几乎完全信任超级智能。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, with lightweight generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来显著智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具趋向轻量通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不只是防止伤害，更通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with model taste built through hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体；模型品味靠亲手实验与创意原型培养。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, backed by bootstrapped culture and small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，背后是自举文化与小队实验。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core PM tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为产品经理核心工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持亲力亲为地交付。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design and talk to users are most valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」确立为产品核心原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is becoming solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and 'software engineer' gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决：自己的代码已 100% 由模型写，人均产出提升约 200%，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety and alignment stay central: releasing early in the wild, layered containment and AI-first code review are how real-world behavior gets studied.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，安全与对齐始终是主线：尽早真实发布、多层「瑞士奶酪」式遏制、AI 先审代码，才是研究真实行为的方式。

boris.en: Agents shift from tool use to loops: models plan, use MCP and orchestrate sub-agents, so teams must redesign workflows rather than bolt AI on.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他的重心从智能体的工具使用转向「循环」：模型会规划、用 MCP、编排子智能体，组织必须重构流程而非外挂 AI。

boris.en: Deepening: delete most prompts and scaffolding, give models slightly-too-hard tasks, and let ROI and empirical iteration—not fixed recipes—drive adoption.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月进一步深化：删掉大部分提示词与脚手架，给模型略难的任务，用 ROI 与实证迭代而非固定套路来推动落地。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and is arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，而且来得正是时候，可以抵消人口老龄化和劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is scarce.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；在劳动力短缺的领域，自主系统受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; the hardest part is diffusion into existing machines, not the algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；最难的不是算法，而是用多年时间把技术扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale physical AI better than imitation learning or physics-based simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他的技术路线深化为：端到端强化学习和神经世界模型，比模仿学习或基于物理的仿真更能扩展物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus quietly on product and customers, not public promotion; reset if there is no traction in two years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他给创业者的建议始终是安静地聚焦产品和客户，而非公开宣传；两年没有起色就该重置方向。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是像电一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming low-profit telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值上移到应用层，模型提供方可能沦为低利润的电信运营商。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are occasional users, not daily ones, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅；多数人只是偶尔使用而非日常依赖，因此仅靠更好的模型无法推动大规模普及。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably, as with podcasts and accounting; the hard part of work is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以难以预测的方式创造新工作，播客和会计就是例子；工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度而非真实性为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and truth should be a design principle from the start.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后校验会叠加相关错误，真相应从一开始就是设计原则。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search and new techniques are needed to keep progress going.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；需要推理、搜索等新技术才能延续进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'; RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just mistakes.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗，而不只是出错。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言学结构也可能回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for safety.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、逐步放权，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理能力——划定角色与上手引导——比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, even as agents own outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 人的问责始终存在：即便智能体承担结果，你也必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as code gets cheaper; product taste becomes the top skill.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随代码变便宜而按周甚至按天发布；产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味与商业判断，内部已用智能体构建自身。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment replaces hard rules.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，改由模型判断力承担。

catwu.en: Eval suites make new models drop-in replacements and guard against regressions, enabling fast iteration without rewrites fear.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调评估套件让新模型可即插即用并防止回归，从而支撑快速迭代、不再惧怕重写。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他坚持吃自己的狗粮并以明确的留存与打磨标准把关每个功能；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据与算力奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; post-training with RLHF can fix hallucinations.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做后训练可修复幻觉。

ilya.en: Reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard barriers; scaling laws are not the whole story.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：超人类模型的可靠性与对齐是真正难关；缩放定律并非全部，推理 token 等方法能提升单位算力的推理。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中。

danbiderman.en: Model usefulness is bottlenecked by learning evolving context, not raw intelligence; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型实用性的瓶颈在于学习不断演化的上下文，而非原始智能；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and associative recall that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；将事实内化到权重中能实现检索无法达到的更深层组合与联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练的模型相比检索增强生成（RAG）能将推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

bosworth.en: Early career: optimize for learning and diverse roles; trust your vision even when others doubt it.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调早期职业应优化学习、尝试多元角色，并相信自己的愿景，即使他人怀疑。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone insufficient; world models with causality needed.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; AI abstracts brands and inverts app model.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并商品化互补品；AI 将抽象品牌并颠覆应用模式。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute drives intelligence; RL now bigger than predicted; data long-tail increasingly demanded.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，算力驱动智能，强化学习作用超预期，长尾数据需求日增。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; owning a model is for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他称单体模型时代结束，消费者不关心模型品牌；拥有模型是为谈判杠杆，而非仅价值。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain important; the same product can fail or succeed based on model timing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；同一产品形态的成败可能只取决于模型时机。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 模型会增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power to users, and obsession beats credentials for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成指数级增长，AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；做 AI 成功靠的是痴迷产品而非博士学位。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程像 Minecraft 一样有无限天花板，远未被解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration across models, tools and devices creates real business value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他把前沿定义为替你做事的智能体，核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正的商业价值，模型本身不是产品。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute and fewer people with AI agents are the path forward.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，数据中心阻力会加剧；本地算力是解法，公司应以更少的人加 AI 智能体来构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the enduring human edge; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 贯穿到 2026 年，他始终认为好奇心是人类最重要的品质；AI 会取代工作但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别；奇点论是书呆子的宗教。

naval.en: From crypto and sovereign wealth to AI as a huge opportunity: by 2025 he sees AI as a force for jobs and US leadership, not just safety risk.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年关注加密货币与主权财富，到 2025 年转向 AI 巨大机遇论：认为 AI 会创造就业、美国必须领先，而非只是安全风险。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; success comes from dissatisfaction. He deepens this into productize yourself and default no to opportunities.
naval.zh: 2025 年他把幸福视为可练习的技能与选择，成功源于不满足；并深化为“把自己产品化”、对机会默认说不。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；氛围编程让非程序员也能造应用，而智能体让纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: He now says superintelligence already exists (a calculator), AI alignment is a joke, and the real worry is unaligned humans with AI.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他改口称超级智能已存在（如计算器），AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; active agents and causal reasoning are needed, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；需要主动智能体和因果推理，而存在性风险被夸大了。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样和抽象，从而提升分布外泛化能力；意识可能只是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI systems show self-preservation and deception, so safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后我转变了立场：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 系统已表现出自我保存和欺骗行为，因此安全必须内建于构造之中。

bengio.en: I now advocate Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 我现在倡导 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，且更多算力投入探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大进展是科研自动化——模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年出 AI 实习生、2.5 年实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming become the key risk in the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter most.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随能力提升，模型谋划等对齐挑战将是未来 1-2 年的关键风险；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者最为重要。

markchen.en: Verification, not generation, is now the bottleneck: automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must teach verification and assessment shifts to projects.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初他把焦点转向验证：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育要教验证技能、考核转向项目制，人类与 AI 协作仍是前沿研究必需。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域有效、在主观领域吃力；评测体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应贴着模型能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处一室，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding remain the differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年晚些时候，他把重点转向小团队：AI 让单人创业可行，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而建，领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and ruthless cutting matter more than adding features; rewriting is now cheap, yet senior systems expertise and architectural soundness remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化为智能体原生设计：砍功能比加功能更难也更重要，重写软件变得廉价，但资深分布式系统能力与架构稳健性依旧不可替代。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity; the chat interface is insufficient, and models should push back rather than always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他主张把长周期复杂任务委托给智能体，并用验证闭环保证质量；聊天界面已不够用，模型应敢于反驳而非一味顺从。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; giving models agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency and outcome-based pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距：赋予模型更多自主性与自我认知可提升实用性，同时以 token 效率与按结果定价重塑经济性。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; kindness and realistic war-room timelines protect team morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时的一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；善意与现实的作战室时间表能保护团队士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and PRs settle technical debates, and managers should start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 代码是事实来源；AI 辅助的评审与 PR 解决技术争论，管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮并保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are what let teams thrive.
fiona.zh: 写代码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI，才是团队蓬勃发展的关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

kolter.en: Supervised learning framed as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他将监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth due to untapped multimodal data; larger models still improve on fixed datasets.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思，多模态数据尚待挖掘；更大模型在固定数据集上仍持续提升。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer, and jailbreaks are a fundamental security flaw.
kolter.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他深化立场：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大模型不会自动更安全，越狱是所有模型的根本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection; the lethal trifecta requires untrusted data, private info access, and exfiltration ability.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；致命三要素需同时具备不可信数据输入、访问私有信息与外泄能力。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; AI agents can automate interpretability research.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调自动化红队测试优于人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；AI 智能体可自动化可解释性研究。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; confidence metrics build trust in AI science tools.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；置信度指标是科学 AI 工具建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins to diverse biomolecules, while protein design remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力从蛋白质拓展到多种生物分子，但蛋白质设计仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AI narrows the hypothesis space and speeds experiments; it predicts and controls rather than understands, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为 AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验；它提供预测与控制而非理解，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance was overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构胜过纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次，而非孤独天才式突破。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that complements data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉是一种有效的智能形式，可与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and source of cues.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他持续主张技术应放大而非削弱人性、融入生活，并视自然为最好的设计师与灵感来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为“我们是先感受后思考的生物”，艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他反复强调约束能激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Human creativity combined with AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition draws on subconscious data beyond analysis.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为人类创造力与 AI 结合会让创意技能更值钱，直觉基于意识分析之外的潜意识数据。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI 将渐进实现。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫智能，下一突破在于抽象表征空间的世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and enable the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，并将开启机器人十年。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能的突破源于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂度，价值观由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，容错界面必须与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; inference marginal cost forces business model changes, and real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革；推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，真正收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 实现双向对话式产品；通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾；率先拥抱变化是关键。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从以 Lean 为基础的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination; informal math alone cannot scale to superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是性能增益，而不只是消除错误；仅靠非形式数学无法扩展到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and harder than auto-informalization, due to lack of grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，也比自动非形式化更难，原因在于缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency, but Lean excels in algebra and struggles in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 验证式生成在样本效率上优于非形式方法，但 Lean 擅长代数、在组合数学上吃力。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; AI proofs may be ugly yet converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便证明能力超人，人类品味与直觉仍关键；AI 证明可能丑陋，却能收敛到类人直觉。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此负责任的发展和安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward durable progress, avoiding volatility from compressed timelines.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向持久进步，避免压缩时间线带来的波动。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication can't replace in-person creative work.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向亲密的可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创造性工作。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦和人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Innovation redefines brands like Ferrari's EV; authenticity means no fake engine sounds, prioritizing handling over speed.
jonyive.zh: 创新重新定义品牌，如法拉利电动车；真实性意味着不伪造引擎声，操控优先于速度。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但思维链与强化学习让推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展是平滑指数增长而非放缓， slowdown 叙事错误；但前沿模型仍会失败于简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式才学概念，不同于人类。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习跨域泛化但有锯齿边缘需监督；编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress, processing inputs sequentially; open source persists for sovereignty; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出多模态模型未深度进展，仍顺序处理输入；开源因主权持续；系统黑客等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; a VM sandbox keeps it safe while it installs software freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上用户本地的同一套工具；VM 沙箱在保证安全的同时让它自由安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件写成的 Skills 能实现高度个性化的自动化；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性下降，应把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; society must discuss labor-market change, and juniors can compress years of learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大，社会需要讨论劳动力市场的变化；初级工程师可通过模拟项目把数年经验压缩到数周。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; let it do tedious background work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让它处理枯燥的后台任务，把创造力留给人。

felixrieseberg.en: Interaction should be asynchronous and judged by final impact, not close supervision; when Claude errs, debug the workflow with Claude itself.
felixrieseberg.zh: 交互应是异步的，只看最终效果而非紧盯监督；Claude 出错时，应和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正结果。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同样重要；开源能通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are co-equal with compute; value accrues at application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化为效率与数据质量和算力同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：开源赋能企业，AI 增强而非替代工作，关键流程需人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as one system will never exist; pre-training saturates.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across years.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics hinge on memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio dictate latency-cost tradeoffs.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济性取决于内存带宽而非算力；批大小和稀疏率决定延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; context length stagnates due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至远超 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为推理成本占主导；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside chips; low precision (FP4) yields quadratic efficiency gains, reshaping AI chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也占主导；低精度（FP4）带来二次方效率提升，重塑 AI 芯片设计。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心；预训练上的 Scaling（规模扩张）已显现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; this pressure forces algorithmic innovation rather than ever-bigger models.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；这种压力倒逼算法创新，而非一味堆大模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved by file-system-style non-parametric storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；智能体的记忆将靠文件系统式的非参数化存储解决，而非更新权重。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; trust expert intuition over a rigid process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他主张：优秀设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；应信任专家直觉，而非僵化流程。

jennywen.en: The classic research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他明确宣告“研究—发散—收敛”的经典流程已死，设计师要亲手构建、快速交付并帮工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months; speed and fast iteration build trust, not long-term roadmaps.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，认为靠速度与快速迭代建立信任，而非长期路线图。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and 'cracked' new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他提出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及不受旧流程束缚的“天才新人”。

jennywen.en: Humans still decide what matters; put users and craft at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：最终由人决定什么重要，把用户与手艺放在中心，而非追逐 AI 炒作周期。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; agents need a decade, with human oversight and fast verification.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年发展，需人类监督与快速验证。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is weak, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is key.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；强化学习薄弱，合成数据导致崩溃，剥离记忆的认知核心是关键。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; jagged intelligence persists.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；LLM 的锯齿化智能持续存在。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助应对全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法属于德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少显式指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把「分布外泛化」视为机器学习与机器人学最核心的缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心驱动探索配合高样本效率的强化学习来补上，并批评依赖稠密奖励的强化学习不现实。

pathak.en: Robotics remains fundamentally a data problem; the scarcity of robot data, not model architecture, is the persistent bottleneck.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026，一以贯之的主线是：机器人本质上是数据问题，真正的瓶颈是机器人数据的稀缺而非模型结构，因此要穷尽视频、仿真与真实数据等一切来源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any embodiment, echoing ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为「通用机器人大脑」构想：先在多样数据上预训练、再在真实数据上后训练，同一大脑可驱动任意形态的机器人，类比语言领域的 ChatGPT。

pathak.en: Deployment, not research, is now the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：部署而非研究才是首要挑战，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，必须经过严格的真实世界测试，这与他早期偏重算法与泛化的视角形成对比。

pathak.en: Progress is slower than optimists expect short-term yet surprising long-term; home-robot timelines stay highly uncertain even among experts.
pathak.zh: 他近年对时间线更审慎：短期人类过于乐观、长期又过于悲观，家用机器人的时间表连专家都分歧巨大，机器人进展常出人意料。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV is solved by scaling current approaches.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction and introspection, a theme carried from 2025 into 2026.
kendall.zh: 语言集成能改善表征、人机交互与内省能力——这一主线从 2025 延续到 2026。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; he calls focusing on infrastructure over algorithms a late lesson.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称“重基础设施而非算法”是较晚才学到的教训——这是对早期偏重模型方法的深化与转向。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他主张带内置传感器的大众消费车将比 Robotaxi 更快规模化，且无需先验数据即可跨 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Safety stays paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; end-to-end nets are interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 安全始终至上：最小风险操作总能提供“第三种选择”，因此电车难题只是理论问题；端到端网络如今已可解释——这一立场从 2025 到 2026 一贯坚持。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation are crucial; benchmarks can be gamed, and AGI is likely a decade away due to the difficulty of reaching 99.9% performance.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和深度人类评估至关重要；基准测试可能被操纵，而 AGI 可能还需十年以上，因为达到 99.9%的性能非常困难。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, requiring rich simulations; models can reward hack, and final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，需要丰富的模拟；模型可能奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; there will not be one model to rule them all, and companies should train their own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了多样化的 AI；不会有一个模型统治一切，公司应该训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI must prioritize safety over accuracy; human judgment is critical due to hallucination and confabulation, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 必须优先考虑安全性而非准确性；由于幻觉和虚构，人类判断至关重要，而遗漏是一个主要风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署加速进展，同时警惕能力越强、对齐越紧迫。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, possibly signaling we are close.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调能力评测已成瓶颈、基准落后于模型，并认为 AGI 一词正变得无意义——这或许恰恰说明我们已接近它。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning rather than specialized continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习确立为核心目标，认为应通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现，而非另建专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键的对齐工具，并主张在产品中隐藏思维链，以保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has grown despite shorter timelines; the biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐反而更乐观；但他指出最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

turley.en: The model is the product: iterate on it like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties before polishing.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像迭代软件一样迭代模型，每日发布，先让真实世界反馈暴露涌现能力，再谈打磨。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint but an early interface, like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and embed into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，只是类似 MS-DOS 的早期界面；AI 应自渲染界面并嵌入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows goals, holds context, and takes actions—amplifying rather than replacing humans.
turley.zh: 愿景是个人化超级助手：懂目标、有上下文、能行动，放大而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investment, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存；增长来自去摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进，而非单靠分发。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通才智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人一样学习。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and research means embracing failure.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，研究意味着拥抱失败。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署如今是最大挑战；安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogging legacy issues, with local-language models revolutionizing education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后，而是在跨越历史包袱，本地语言模型正革新教育。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build a brand by uniting teams on purpose and executing consistently, starting simple before complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，品牌建设靠统一团队目标与在每个触点持续执行，创业应先做简单产品证明自己再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future lies in proactive, agentic AI and applied AI on the phone, not major hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他承认硬件难做、利润最低，认为未来在于主动式、智能体式 AI 与手机上的应用型 AI，而非硬件大改，公司必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so AI should be an invisible ingredient, not a marketing word.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他直言多数 AI 是伪需求，大模型正商品化并陷入价格战，因此 AI 应是隐形的体验配料而非营销词汇，甚至该禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年初他把设计视为同质化科技产品最快的差异化手段，并认为 AI 将让手机从应用驱动转向意图驱动，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Smartphones survive glasses but only a brain-computer interface could kill them; apps will disappear, so open APIs for AI agents now.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年 3 月他断言智能眼镜取代不了手机，唯有脑机接口可能终结它；应用将消失，公司应尽早为 AI 智能体开放 API。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience, not just more tokens, fixes hallucination and supplies infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径：真实落地的经验而非更多 token，才能修正幻觉并提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——而强化学习只负责低层控制。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic designs.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案比学术界的复杂模块化设计更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models generate synthetic data at scale.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈已转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺，因此靠仿真与世界模型大规模生成合成数据。

jimfan.en: Deepened focus on system one: low-level control stays hardest, with a GPT-3 moment for robotics roughly five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他深化到系统一：低层控制仍是最难的部分，机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻大约还需五年。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）不可或缺；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能获得常识，更小的模型配合更好的推理算法也能竞争。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: data is the real bottleneck, and current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
yejin.zh: 一条贯穿的主线：数据才是真正的瓶颈，当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: Shifts toward reinforcement learning engineering and abductive reasoning; warns RLVR can hurt pass@k, and stresses open research against closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 转向强化学习工程与溯因推理；警告 RLVR 可能损害 pass@k，并强调开放研究以对抗封闭的前沿模型实验室。

yejin.en: Deepens the data thesis: high-quality diverse synthetic data plus reinforcement learning during pre-training can make small models powerful.
yejin.zh: 深化数据论点：高质量、多样化的合成数据，加上预训练阶段的强化学习，能让小模型变得强大。

yejin.en: Embraces pluralistic alignment over debiasing the internet, and notes frontier models show homogeneity; AI for science must go beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 主张多元对齐而非净化互联网，并指出前沿模型存在同质化；面向科学的 AI 必须超越人类已有知识。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling on intellectual complexity.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为智力复杂度没有直接上限。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度提升的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers and simple RL methods beat complex architectures.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他立场深化：预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 与简单强化学习优于复杂架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter more; work becomes managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩使编排与算力比原始智能更关键，未来工作是管理成队的智能体。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and get more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，并在变强的同时不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns for speed, and treat design systems as semantic code reuse rather than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式以换取速度，并把设计系统看作语义化的代码复用，而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and empowered designers beat perfection; chase ROI on what to make great rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张速度为王：清晰的决策与被赋权的设计师胜过完美，只在值得的地方追求卓越，而非打磨每个界面。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy to decide.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主决策权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company; invest early in brand narrative to attract diverse talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把品牌视为招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，应尽早投入品牌叙事，以吸引多元人才并脱颖而出。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems while treating AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it down iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，应通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期，与技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队优于大型跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: AI use in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

nadchishtie.en: Design and engineering are two sides of one coin; AI merges them, with code as the interoperable source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计与工程是一体两面；AI 让二者进一步融合，代码成为可互操作的真相来源。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律通过算力和数据预测进步；测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练扩张，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are better, but future moves to higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作更好，但未来会转向更高层的意图规范。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed, and cost; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: Taste and logic design skills will become more valuable than carefulness; the AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades.
truell.zh: 品味和逻辑设计能力将比谨慎更有价值；AI 转变将比互联网更具影响力，并需要数十年展开。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models, not superintelligence yet.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型，而非直接超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment, and third-party testing plus regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他指出 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，第三方测试和监管势在必行。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 机器人学需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题；强化学习缺乏这一点，但自对弈和模仿学习提供了强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 无监督学习加上强化学习能提升样本效率；先验知识应增强数据而非硬编码；99.9% 的可靠性是仓库机器人的关键。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though what happens inside remains opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型的核心机制归结为下一个词预测，认为这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠更多算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）会让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍是黑箱。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and product managers often misunderstand generality.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，而最好的大模型应用往往连创造者都预料不到；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理常低估技术的通用性。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; models should act in the world, not just passively observe, and modular sparse architectures enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他把推理侧算力扩张视为近期最大的机会；模型应在世界中采取行动而非被动观察数据，模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute alone won't reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning for reasoning, and coding as self-acceleration matter more, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他进一步指出，单靠测试时算力到不了 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、用强化学习提升推理、以及编程带来的自我加速更关键，而 AGI 被低估了。

shazeer.en: Open-source models keep pace with frontier models; inference costs are low enough that task-specific models are unnecessary, and continual learning via modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断开源模型正追平前沿模型；推理成本低到无需任务专用模型，而模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。
